headline: Wakefit Innovations files SEBI Regulation 31(4) substantial acquisition disclosure
sum: Wakefit Innovations Limited has submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under the SEBI Takeover Code to NSE, signalling a substantial acquisition of shares or imminent open offer by a new investor or acquirer.
implication: Regulation 31(4) disclosures are mandatory pre-open-offer filings when an acquirer crosses or proposes to cross the 25% shareholding threshold; review of the full disclosure document is essential to identify the acquirer identity, stake acquired, consideration and timeline for any mandatory open offer.
detail: Wakefit Innovations Limited, a consumer furniture and mattress retail company, has filed a formal takeover-code disclosure with NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This disclosure is a mandatory prerequisite to any open offer or substantial stake acquisition above regulatory thresholds. The exact acquirer identity, acquisition price, shareholding percentage, and open-offer timeline are contained in the full disclosure document filed with the exchange.
